messages:
Lena G: quick a11y check — keyboard users lose their spot when jumping between the Summary panel and the Details rail. It's jarring. Anyone seen this?
Tom S: Yep. The rail opens but focus stays on body; screen readers announce nothing. We should move programmatic focus into the rail on open.
Priya N: Agreed. Proposal: set tabindex='-1' on the rail container, call rail.focus() when opened, then move into previously-focused element if we remember one.
Hector V: For remembering, use a tiny map keyed by rail id and store a data-focus-key on important controls. Example: `savedFocus[railId] = el.getAttribute('data-focus-key')`. On open: try `rail.querySelector('[data-focus-key="'+savedFocus[railId]+'"]').focus()` else focus heading.
Lena G: Nice. Also some icon-only toggles lack aria-labels and some use title attr; replace titles with aria-label and role='button'.
Tom S: And don't forget aria-controls + aria-expanded on triggers so SRs know rail state. Consider an aria-live='polite' sr-only region for confirmations like "Details expanded" but avoid repeating aria-expanded text.
accessibility-bot: ⚠️ scan: 3 issues found: low contrast on .chip--muted (2.7:1), icon buttons missing accessible name, focus outline smaller than recommended on .circle-btn.
Priya N: For contrast, swap muted token to neutral-600 (checked 4.6:1). For focus, spec a 3px solid outline with visible color in both light/dark tokens.
Hector V: Also a behavior nit: card list intercepts arrow keys for paging but isn't a composite widget. Either remove arrow handlers or implement roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant.
Lena G: Let's do short action list: (1) Hector - implement rail focus on open + remember/restore (PR Wed), (2) Tom - sweep icon-only buttons to add aria-labels & roles (PR Thu), (3) Priya - design token swaps for muted chips + focus specs (PR Fri). I'll run VoiceOver & NVDA after merges. :thumbsup:
accessibility-bot: ✅ Re-run requested after PRs land.
Tom S: One more copy nudge: status chips should read full words (e.g., "Healthy" vs "ok") so screen readers are clear.
Lena G: Good point — updating copy doc now. Thanks everyone!
